<!-- pr-reviewer: e04cf9f829b78a59b20e00945c3a3b2375efed34 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** Two findings: one blocker (a gap in the proof), one request (line endings).

**What looks good**
- The narrow cases are conservative. `#[cfg(any(test, feature = ..))]`, a plain `mod`, a `#[path]` on the declaration, an inline or indented `mod`, a `[lib]`/`[[bin]]` `path` in the manifest, and a `#[path]`/`include!` in `src/` that names the file all give the crate reach. The probes confirmed the cases below.
- `build.rs`, `Cargo.toml`, `lib.rs` and assets stay wide. Dry-run probes: `motion/Cargo.toml` and `motion/src/lib.rs` reach 95 steps. `motion/src/drilling/boss.rs` reaches 95 steps. A test-only file together with a library file keeps the wide reach.
- The dry-run prints each skipped step and the count. `motion/src/ring_zig_tests.rs` gives 3 steps reached, 99 skipped.
- `Process change: yes` is in the body. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched. The decision file `docs/decisions/3560-heavy-reach-files.md` is complete. New files have a provenance line. `heavy.rs` is 178 lines.

**Results** (locally, merged with main `01e177bf5`, which is already in the PR head; the runner was not used because `xtask/` changed)
- `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask --bin xtask`: 328 passed, 0 failed.
- `xtask` integration binaries (`docs_images`, `example_line_endings`, `lane_verdict`, `merge_ready_skill`, `merge_review`, `post_merge_*`, `release_site_tests`, `review_artifacts`): all pass.
- Not run: `xtask/tests/catalog.rs`. The full `cargo test -p xtask` timed out at 590 s because `catalog` builds `camcraft-cli` and its dependencies. The PR does not touch it.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: the diff reaches no heavy lane (xtask only), and no heavy lane ran ("Heavy lanes at review", #3556).

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: the test-only proof reads one compile root.** `seen_by` proves `UnitTestsOnly` from the `lib.rs` module tree, and it scans only `src/` for a path string. The package has other compile roots that it does not read. A file that is `#[cfg(test)]` in `lib.rs` can still be built into another target. I ran three probes in a scratch crate (a temporary test, removed again):
   - `lib.rs` has `#[cfg(test)] mod t;` and `src/main.rs` has `mod t;`: the answer is `UnitTestsOnly`. The binary builds `t.rs`. (`heavy_files.rs:23-53`, `decl_is_test_only` reads only the parent file in the `lib.rs` tree.)
   - `tests/x.rs` has `#[path = "../src/t.rs"] mod t;`: the answer is `UnitTestsOnly`. `named_by_path_or_include` (`heavy_files.rs:133-154`) walks only `src/`, not `tests/`, `benches/`, `examples/` or `build.rs`.
   - A `src/bin/b.rs` with `#[path = "../t.rs"]` is caught (answer `Library`). That case is fine.

   No file in the repository has this shape today, so no lane is lost now. The next such file loses its integration binary silently. The `d:lib`-only reach is only sound if no other root builds the file.

   Please add one rule that closes the class: **a file is `UnitTestsOnly` only if no other compile root can name it.** Read every `.rs` file of the crate directory (`src/`, `tests/`, `benches/`, `examples/`, `build.rs`) and answer `Library` if any line, outside the `lib.rs` declaration, names the file as a path part (as now) or declares `mod <stem>;` (a second declaration of the same module name in any other root). A rule of this shape also covers a root that you have not thought of. Please pin it with the three probes above as tests (one for `main.rs`, one for `tests/`, one for `benches/` or `build.rs`).

2. **Class: line endings.** `xtask/src/heavy.rs` and `xtask/src/heavy_files_tests.rs` are committed with CRLF. Main has LF, and `heavy_files.rs` is LF. The diff of `heavy.rs` shows the whole file as changed (327 lines for a 37-line change with `--ignore-space-at-eol`). This will conflict with each other PR that touches `heavy.rs`. Please commit the files with LF. One rule that closes the class: check `git diff origin/main --stat --ignore-space-at-eol` against the plain stat before you push. The two must agree for the files that you change.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- A diff that touches `src/bin/..` prints about 100 lines `app heavy: <suite> - ... [no #[ignore]d test: no step]`. A `[no step]` line for a target that has no ignored test adds noise. Consider hiding it in the dry-run.
- `BinsOnly` is sound only while no other crate runs a binary of this crate. I found none today (each `CARGO_BIN_EXE_*` use is in the crate of the binary). The decision file says this. Keep it in mind when you add a cross-crate test.

This head needs a fresh review after the fix. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d1eb8402018c2c394d46ee8d98fe2cfa50e7917c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is a delta review of `e04cf9f82..d1eb84020`.

**Both earlier findings are closed**
- Finding 1 (the `UnitTestsOnly` proof): the rule that I asked for is in place. `seen_by` now reads every `.rs` file of the crate directory (`heavy_files.rs` `rust_files`, with `src/bin`, `tests/`, `benches/`, `examples/`). It answers `Library` when:
  - a file names the changed file as a path part (`#[path]`, `include!`);
  - a file other than the proven parent has a `mod <seg>;` that can load the file or an ancestor module (`declared_elsewhere`, `child_dir`);
  - the `mod <seg>;` is indented.
  - Any unreadable directory or file also answers `Library`.
- The pin `a_second_compile_root_that_names_the_file_keeps_the_crate_reach` covers four cases: `mod t;` in `main.rs`, `#[path]` from `tests/`, `#[path]` from `src/bin/`, and the ancestor case (`mod a;` in `main.rs` for `a/u.rs`). The control case (`mod t;` in `tests/x.rs`) stays narrow. This matches the rule.
- Finding 2 (line endings): `heavy.rs`, `heavy_files.rs`, `heavy_files_tests.rs`, `main.rs` and the decision file have no CR in the PR blobs. `git diff --stat origin/main` shows 37 insertions and 4 deletions for `heavy.rs`, not a whole-file rewrite.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3560-heavy-reach-files.md` shows the new rule.
- Process rules: the body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Refs #3560`. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`. The new files have provenance lines and are under 400 lines.

**Results, merged with origin/main (`01e177bf5`, the merge was empty), locally**
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6 cargo test -j 6 -p xtask --bin xtask`: 329 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `xtask/tests/catalog.rs`: not run (it builds `camcraft-cli` and times out; the maintainer asked to skip it).

**Heavy lanes:** not run, as ordered. The diff changes only `xtask/` and `docs/`, so it reaches no product heavy lane.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The side effect that you named is real. `crates/motion/src/drilling/tests.rs` now goes wide, because `crates/motion/tests/stock_seam.rs:23` has the string `"tests.rs"` (a file-name filter in a directory walk). The path-part match is coarse for generic names such as `tests.rs` or `mod.rs`. It errs in the safe direction (more lanes, never fewer). If the noise shows up often, a later change could match only in `#[path]` and `include!` lines.
- `seen_by` now reads every `.rs` file of the crate for each changed file. This is acceptable for a dry-run planner. Read the files one time for each crate if the plan gets slow.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
